card.name: Separators inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: List separators (commas, dashes, 'and') and the first word of the next item, such as 'hair' or 'sudden', in running lists of symptoms or side effects, just before the next symptom is named.

modes.label: Dash or comma between symptoms
modes.description: A bullet dash or comma that ends one symptom and leads into the next in a side-effect list.
modes.example: Some more serious Ritalin LA side effects include: - Feeling faint <<->> Increased heartbeat - Fever and sore throat

modes.label: Start of next symptom
modes.description: A word that begins the next symptom in the list, such as 'hair' before 'loss' or 'sudden' before 'dizziness'.
modes.example: a sudden big headache,<< sudden>> dizziness, unsteadiness or fall

card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of symptoms where another symptom is about to be named.
